value.note: Catalogue note on the statement "The disk in tray K has a diameter of 18 mm." The supplied bench extract, Entry B-7, identifies the object as the disk in tray K and states that the verified bench record gives its diameter as exactly 16 mm, with no unresolved measurement warning recorded. On that entry alone, the statement of 18 mm is not supported and is inconsistent with the recorded diameter of exactly 16 mm. This conclusion is limited to the supplied synthetic extract and Entry B-7; no missing measurement is guessed and no outside source is used.
